full_text:
2. Describe the action(s) that you believe was (were) discriminatory or in violation of a
federal civil rights law or the HIPAA Privacy, Security or Breach Notification Rules.

Inland Psychiatric Medical Group (L.A. Care Sub-contractor) has repeatedly denied my
requests for my own medical records. This has prevented me from obtaining necessary
evidence for my ongoing healthcare appeals and state hearings.
